records.name: Lumbridge first-relay factual mechanics
records.scope: Factual post-Tutorial arrival, local quest-start outputs, Lumbridge tool prices, first X Marks dig, and two diary task boundaries. It does not select an episode or later route.

tool_shop.boundary: Shop stock and displayed price are live state. Five coins is the listed full-stock baseline, not a guaranteed observed transaction total.

x_marks_first_dig.location: north-west of the window at Bob's Brilliant Axes

hans_age.result: Lumbridge & Draynor Easy task credit after asking Hans for the account's age

pickpocket_citizen.result: Lumbridge & Draynor Easy task credit after one successful pickpocket of a man or woman in Lumbridge
pickpocket_citizen.loot: variable and not a fixed modeled output

records.observation_boundary: Quest starts, first-dig replacement, and diary task credits require player confirmation. Point-in-time item presence can support possession but cannot prove the interactions or provenance.
